# s4communication_communication_user (List Resource)

Lists communication users. Use with `terraform query`, optionally with `-generate-config-out` to write configuration with import blocks. Passwords are never returned by SAP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all communication users. SAP does not return passwords, so generated
# configuration contains none.
list "s4communication_communication_user" "all" {
  provider = s4communication
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list communication users with this name.
